root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemPreferencesHdrTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemPreferencesHdrTbl ( PrefsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_SystemPreferencesHdrTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooCommerceEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SysPrefs_WooEnabled DEFAULT (0), WooWizardCompleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SysPrefs_WooWizard DEFAULT (0), UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); INSERT INTO dbo.SystemPreferencesHdrTbl (PrefsID, WooCommerceEnabled, WooWizardCompleted, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy) VALUES (1, 0, 0, SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ( SettingsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooCommerceSettingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, StoreBaseUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, AdminBaseUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, ConsumerKeyEncrypted NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, ConsumerSecretEncrypted NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, IntegrationEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_Enabled DEFAULT (0), WizardCompleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_Wizard DEFAULT (0), LastConnectionTestUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastConnectionTestOk BIT NULL, LastItemsSyncUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastOrdersSyncUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastOrdersSyncOrderNumber NVARCHAR(50) NULL, LastContactsSyncUtc DATETIME2 NULL, PushEnabledStateToWoo BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_PushEnabled DEFAULT (1), DisableScopeDefault NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_DisableScope DEFAULT (N'MappedOnly'), PullStockQtyEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_PullQty DEFAULT (0), CategoryFilterMode NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_CatMode DEFAULT (N'All'), GuestCheckoutContactMode NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_Guest DEFAULT (N'ZZName'), DispatchDeliveryPersonIds NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_DispatchIds DEFAULT (N'5,7'), TrackingNumberRequired BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_TrackReq DEFAULT (1), DispatchedWooStatus NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_DispStatus DEFAULT (N'processing'), AutoCompleteOnWooCompleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_AutoDone DEFAULT (0), UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); INSERT INTO dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl (SettingsID, IntegrationEnabled, WizardCompleted, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy) VALUES (1, 0, 0, SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl ( FilterID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooCategoryFilterTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooCategoryId BIGINT NOT NULL, CategoryName NVARCHAR(255) NULL, ParentWooCategoryId BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCat_Parent DEFAULT (0), IncludeInSync BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCat_Include DEFAULT (1), DefaultSortValue INT NULL, DefaultImportMode NVARCHAR(32) NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_WooCategoryFilter_WooCategoryId UNIQUE (WooCategoryId) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'ParentWooCategoryId') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl ADD ParentWooCategoryId BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCat_Parent DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'DefaultSortValue') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl ADD DefaultSortValue INT NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'DefaultImportMode') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl ADD DefaultImportMode NVARCHAR(32) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl ( MappingID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooItemMappingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, ItemID INT NOT NULL, WooProductId BIGINT NULL, WooVariationId BIGINT NULL, MapType NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Type DEFAULT (N'Exact'), SkuPattern NVARCHAR(255) NULL, QtyFactor FLOAT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Qty DEFAULT (1), PackagingID INT NULL, DisableScope NVARCHAR(50) NULL, LastSyncedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastWooStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Active DEFAULT (1), IncludeInImport BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Import DEFAULT (1) ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooItemMappings_ItemID ON dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl (ItemID); END
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooSkuWildcardRulesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE dbo.WooSkuWildcardRulesTbl;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl ( ParentID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooAttributeParentTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooAttributeId BIGINT NOT NULL, AttributeName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, Slug NVARCHAR(200) NULL, UseForVariants BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_Use DEFAULT (0), TermCount INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_Terms DEFAULT (0), QtyRank INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_QtyRank0 DEFAULT (0), PackRank INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_PackRank0 DEFAULT (0), NoteRank INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_NoteRank0 DEFAULT (0), CONSTRAINT UQ_WooAttributeParent_WooId UNIQUE (WooAttributeId) ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooAttrParent_Name ON dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl (AttributeName); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'ImportChannel') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl ADD ImportChannel NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_Channel DEFAULT (N'Line'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'QtyRank') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl ADD QtyRank INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_QtyRank DEFAULT (0); END IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'PackRank') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl ADD PackRank INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_PackRank DEFAULT (0); END IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'NoteRank') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl ADD NoteRank INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_NoteRank DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl ( MapID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooAttributeMapTbl PRIMARY KEY, AttributeName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, AttributeOption NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, QtyFactor FLOAT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttr_Qty DEFAULT (1), PackagingID INT NULL, MapRole NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttr_Role DEFAULT (N'Both'), ItemServiceTypeID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttr_Svc DEFAULT (0), IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttr_Active DEFAULT (1), Notes NVARCHAR(255) NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_WooAttributeMap_NameOptionType UNIQUE (AttributeName, AttributeOption, ItemServiceTypeID) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl', N'ResolvePriority') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeParentTbl ADD ResolvePriority INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttrParent_Pri DEFAULT (100); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl', N'MapRole') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl ADD MapRole NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooAttr_Role DEFAULT (N'Both'); END
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl', N'PrepTypeID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl ADD PrepTypeID INT NULL; END
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl', N'PrepTypeID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAttributeMapTbl ADD PrepTypeID INT NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl', N'IncludeInImport') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl ADD IncludeInImport BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Import DEFAULT (1); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooPackagingServiceTypeTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooPackagingServiceTypeTbl ( PackagingServiceTypeID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooPackagingServiceTypeTbl PRIMARY KEY, ItemPackagingID INT NOT NULL, ItemServiceTypeID INT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_WooPackSvc_PackType UNIQUE (ItemPackagingID, ItemServiceTypeID) ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooPackSvc_ServiceType ON dbo.WooPackagingServiceTypeTbl (ItemServiceTypeID); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl ( OrderID BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooOrderInfoTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooOrderId BIGINT NOT NULL, WooOrderNumber NVARCHAR(50) NULL, WooStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PaymentMethod NVARCHAR(100) NULL, PaymentStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PaymentPaid BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooOrd_Paid DEFAULT (0), TrackingNumber NVARCHAR(100) NULL, LastSyncedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, RawSnapshotJson NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_WooOrderInfo_WooOrderId UNIQUE (WooOrderId) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooContactInfoTbl ( ContactID BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooContactInfoTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooCustomerId BIGINT NULL, MatchEmail NVARCHAR(255) NULL, LastSyncedUtc DATETIME2 NULL ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_WooContactInfo_WooCustomerId ON dbo.WooContactInfoTbl (WooCustomerId) WHERE WooCustomerId IS NOT NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooImportBatchesTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooImportBatchesTbl ( BatchID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooImportBatchesTbl PRIMARY KEY, BatchType NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, CreatedUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooBatch_Created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), ConfirmedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Notes NVARCHAR(500) NULL ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooImportBatchLinesTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooImportBatchLinesTbl ( BatchLineID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooImportBatchLinesTbl PRIMARY KEY, BatchID INT NOT NULL, ExternalId NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PreviewJson NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, MatchStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, IsSelected BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooBatchLine_Sel DEFAULT (1), ImportResult NVARCHAR(50) NULL, TrackerEntityId BIGINT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooImportBatchLines_BatchID ON dbo.WooImportBatchLinesTbl (BatchID); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl ( CacheID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooCatalogCacheTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooProductId BIGINT NOT NULL, WooVariationId BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCatCache_Var DEFAULT (0), IsParentGroup BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCatCache_Parent DEFAULT (0), IsVariation BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCatCache_VarFlag DEFAULT (0), Name NVARCHAR(500) NULL, Sku NVARCHAR(255) NULL, ParentSku NVARCHAR(255) NULL, ParentName NVARCHAR(500) NULL, Status NVARCHAR(50) NULL, StockStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, ProductType NVARCHAR(50) NULL, CategoriesLabel NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, CategoryIds NVARCHAR(500) NULL, AttributesJson NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, PulledUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCatCache_Pulled DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), VariationTotalCount INT NULL, VariationInStockCount INT NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_WooCatalogCache_ProductVar UNIQUE (WooProductId, WooVariationId) ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooCatalogCache_Sku ON dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl (Sku); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl', N'VariationTotalCount') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl ADD VariationTotalCount INT NULL; END IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl', N'VariationInStockCount') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCatalogCacheTbl ADD VariationInStockCount INT NULL; END

SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE name IN ( N'SystemPreferencesHdrTbl', N'WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'WooItemMappingsTbl', N'WooAttributeParentTbl', N'WooAttributeMapTbl', N'WooPackagingServiceTypeTbl', N'WooOrderInfoTbl', N'WooContactInfoTbl', N'WooImportBatchesTbl', N'WooImportBatchLinesTbl', N'WooCatalogCacheTbl' ) ORDER BY name;
